notes.TWN: 環境部《2026 年中華民國國家溫室氣體排放清冊報告》：2024 年甲烷排放 435 萬公噸 CO₂ 當量（GWP 28），EDGAR 估計 1,546 萬公噸，是 3.6 倍。主要差在廢水處理（EDGAR 639 萬公噸，清冊 87 萬公噸）與垃圾掩埋等固體廢棄物（EDGAR 437 萬公噸，清冊 56 萬公噸）：台灣的垃圾大多焚化，清冊的掩埋甲烷從 1998 年的 1,096 萬公噸降到 2024 年的 54 萬公噸。稻田與畜牧 EDGAR 328 萬公噸，清冊的農業部門 201 萬公噸（報告的表 ES2.3）。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan's Ministry of Environment, 2026 National Greenhouse Gas Inventory Report: methane emissions in 2024 were 4.3 Mt CO₂e (GWP 28); EDGAR estimates 15.5 Mt, 3.6 times as much. Most of the gap is wastewater (EDGAR 6.4 Mt, inventory 0.9 Mt) and landfills and other solid waste (EDGAR 4.4 Mt, inventory 0.6 Mt): most of Taiwan's rubbish is incinerated, and landfill methane in the inventory fell from 11.0 Mt in 1998 to 0.5 Mt in 2024. Rice and livestock: EDGAR 3.3 Mt, inventory agriculture sector 2.0 Mt (report table ES2.3).
notesEn.SDN: Includes South Sudan, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.

notesEn.SRB: Includes Montenegro and Kosovo, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.CHE: Includes Liechtenstein, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.FRA: Includes Monaco, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.ESP: Includes Andorra, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.ITA: Includes San Marino and Vatican City, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
